The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association has named U.S. District Judge Diana Saldaña as the official Bridge Speaker for the 2027 International Bridge Ceremony, set for Saturday, February 20, 2027.

WBCA announced the selection on Monday, saying Judge Saldaña, a United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas, will serve as speaker for the WBCA/IGNC International Bridge Ceremony, the binational tradition that celebrates the friendship and unity between the United States and Mexico.

Judge Saldaña is a native of Carrizo Springs, Texas. According to WBCA, her journey from migrant student to federal judge is a testament to perseverance, dedication, and service. Since her appointment to the federal bench in 2011, she has remained committed to mentoring young leaders, expanding educational opportunities, and making a lasting impact in the community.

Judge Saldaña is also the founder of the George P. Kazen Fellowship Program, which has empowered more than 100 local high school students through civic education, leadership development, and community service.

"The Ceremony reminds us that our shared common bonds are stronger than what could divide us," Judge Saldaña said, according to WBCA.

As the official 2027 Bridge Speaker, Judge Saldaña also becomes WBCA's newest Ambassador for the 129th Washington's Birthday Celebration, which runs January 14 through February 28, 2027.

The International Bridge Ceremony brings the two nations together through the symbolic Abrazo of children, a longstanding tradition of the celebration.

Sources: Washington's Birthday Celebration Association, Facebook, November 9, 2026; WBCA announcement, wbcalaredo.org.
